name: expo-fastapi-todo
description: A phased tutorial for production-shaped Expo and FastAPI development.

scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.test:api: uv run --directory apps/api python -m pytest tests
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm lint:mobile && pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:mobile && pnpm test:api && pnpm build:web
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:markdown && pnpm lint:links && shellcheck scripts/doctor scripts/check-doc-links scripts/doctor.d/*.sh
scripts.test:e2e:web: uv run --directory apps/api python -m e2e.support prepare && EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8001 pnpm --dir apps/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-e2e && pnpm exec playwright test -c e2e/web/playwright.config.ts
